services.desc: Step One: Click on the “Schedule Your Charter” button below and choose a day for your fishing trip. Step Two: Once your trip is scheduled, clik on the “Fishing Charter Deposit” button and submit a $100 deposit payment. Weather Cancelation Policy:We do NOT cancel trips due to light/moderate rain and wind. Weather cancelations are strictly determined by Captain Mike’s discretion 24 hours ahead of time. If you choose to cancel do to weather based on your discretion you will be charge 50 percent of the trip’s rate. Reel Cast Charters is a full-time Connecticut-based sport fishing guide service specializing guided fishing trips in the Connecticut waters of Long Island
